# OpenWiki INSTRUCTIONS — ecshopx-admin

User-authored scope and priority brief for `openwiki/`. Routine openwiki init/update should not rewrite this file.

## Scope

Document **ecshopx-admin** (Vue admin) with priority on the **大转盘抽奖** feature set under marketing:

- 列表 / 编辑 / 终止 / 复制 / 统计导出
- 装修路径挂载抽奖活动
- 管理端对接的 promotions 接口契约

Out of scope for this brief: Vshop/H5 用户端交互实现（仅在契约 §2 留联调对照）。

## Priorities

1. **Contract first** — Admin 联调以 `openwiki/api/lottery-wheel-contract.md` 为准；冲突回退 GitLab PRD `ECX-9907-lottery-wheel.md`。
2. **Evidence** — 每个结论引用 `src/...` 真实路径；无证据则标「待验证」。
3. **Task map** — 需求切片以 `openwiki/marketing/lottery/requirements.md` 为准（排除 Vshop 任务）。

## Sources of truth

| 类型 | 来源 |
|------|------|
| 接口契约 | INT-01 / ECX-9971 冻结稿（已落入本 wiki） |
| 产品 PRD | `ecshopx-product` → `prds/active/ECX-9907-lottery-wheel.md` |
| 原型 | Axhub：https://axhub.it.shopex123.com/pro/50zxABEUWFH/ （父任务 ECX-9907） |
| 代码索引 | 本仓 `.codegraph/`（`codegraph init`） |

## Boundaries

- 不把 Vshop 抽奖页实现细节写入 Admin wiki 正文。
- 不把 Operator JWT / 密钥写入 wiki。
- 现有遗留双路由 `/marketing/wheel` 与 `/marketing/interactive/lottery` 需在文档中标明，避免落地时跳错路径。

pages.title: Lottery Wheel Admin and API Contract
pages.purpose: Refresh the frozen INT-01 reference with repository-backed Admin endpoint wrappers, request field mapping, status and error semantics, versioning, prize schema, reporting, and the explicit Admin versus user-facing boundary.
instructions: Keep Admin contract-first priority: use INT-01 as the Admin integration authority and fall back to the GitLab PRD only for conflicts explicitly recorded by the repository brief.
Keep the Vshop/H5 section limited to the contract-level integration comparison; do not document user-client implementation details.
Never document Operator JWT or secret values. Use Mermaid for request/lifecycle material where it clarifies the contract.
Verify every endpoint, method, field, status, and error claim against current source; distinguish direct Finder URLs from named API wrappers.

pages.title: Runtime Architecture and Access Model
pages.purpose: Explain Vue 2 startup, plugin composition, portal-aware routing and permissions, persisted Vuex state, active API request boundary, and how these infrastructure systems constrain feature changes.
instructions: Do not document operator JWT contents or secrets.
Treat source and tests as authoritative; distinguish the active `src/api/request/` client from legacy or alternate request wrappers.
When documenting startup, authentication, request, or state flows, include Mermaid diagrams grounded in inspected code.

pages.title: Lottery Wheel Admin Code Map

instructions: Correct stale route direction: `/marketing/interactive/lottery` is the canonical route; `/marketing/wheel` and `/marketing/membermarket/wheel` redirect to it.
Map actual callers to API wrappers and direct Finder URLs, including the decoration picker and shared API aggregation behavior.
Record observed gaps or inconsistencies as evidence-backed risks, not assumed fixes.

pages.title: Lottery Wheel Admin Requirements
pages.purpose: Maintain the Admin-only task and acceptance map for list, editor, termination, copy, statistics/export, and decoration mounting, tied to the current implementation and frozen contract.
instructions: Cite current `src/...` paths for implementation status and mark absent test evidence as pending verification.
Keep the task map scoped to Admin and exclude Vshop tasks.
Use the contract for HTTP paths and error codes and the PRD only for explicitly recorded product decisions; identify unresolved mismatches such as cost-value rules rather than silently choosing one.

Include the two platform build variants and explain that `VUE_APP_*` values are baked in at build time.
Use current repository evidence for Node and container versions, resolving discrepancies between README, `.nvmrc`, package engines, and Dockerfile instead of repeating stale claims.

pages.title: Integrations, Automation, and Verification
pages.purpose: Catalog external service boundaries and concrete repository checks, hooks, scripts, build verification, OpenWiki automation, and the absence or presence of focused tests relevant to safe changes.
instructions: Do not document provider credentials, JWTs, or secret environment values.
For lottery integration verification, include promotions endpoints, coupon/coupon-package picker dependencies, decoration activity selection, and focused manual cases grounded in source.
Inspect current manifests and workflows before claiming a test runner or CI behavior; distinguish available lint/build/targeted scripts from absent general unit/E2E coverage.

pages.title: ECShopX Admin Source Map
pages.purpose: Provide a concise ownership navigator from runtime infrastructure and portal routing to API modules, parallel view trees, lottery implementation, shared pickers, localization, build configuration, and quality automation.

pages.title: Feature and Fix Change Guide

instructions: For lottery changes, route through the contract, requirements, and workflow pages and preserve route aliases, optimistic versioning, prize validation, export semantics, and decoration picker behavior.
Preserve repository engineering constraints from `AGENTS.md`, including small scoped changes, active request-client conventions, and synchronized locale handling.

pages.title: Commerce Administration Domains

Use route/import evidence to resolve the parallel `src/view/` and `src/views/` trees.
